verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's developer docs say you can pull data out to build dashboards, sync to other systems and analyze marketing performance, and that its public APIs let you read Klaviyo data headlessly. However, no specific campaign or flow performance reporting endpoint is documented in the evidence; flow performance reports are mentioned only through the MCP server. Missing for 10: documented campaign/flow metrics or reporting API endpoints, warehouse-export guidance, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull campaign and flow performance metrics through the API into my own warehouse or dashboards

citations.quote: Pull data from Klaviyo to create dashboards, sync to other systems, and perform analysis to keep up with your marketing performance.
Klaviyo is also accessible headlessly — through its public APIs and MCP server — so people and AI agents can read, write, and act on Klaviyo data from outside the Klaviyo interface.
